_comment: Limits for the matching data monitor (scripts/m01_data_drift.py). Rates are absolute changes against the baseline window; PSI (product codes, manufacturers: the baseline's top 50 plus 'other') 0.1 warns and 0.25 is drift. A window with fewer than min_rows new rows gives no decision. Set 2026-11-19 before any check ran; review after the first real decisions.
